what: Documented two Windows/tooling gotchas discovered while verifying the homepage metric: Git Bash silently breaks exact-PID taskkill flags unless they're //escaped, and an orphaned stale-build server on a test port can make new changes look missing.
why: Future verification sessions won't misdiagnose stale-server output as a code bug, and exact-PID kills (per the no-name-kill rule) will actually work the first time from Git Bash.
summary: Recorded two learnings from the last-30-days metric session: (1) Git Bash path-mangles /PID-style taskkill flags — use //PID //T //F and verify the port is freed; (2) an orphaned preview server serving a stale build makes fresh changes look missing — identify the process serving the port before debugging code.
